overview_description.description: Wasel is a transportation platform that connects passengers with professional drivers for convenient, reliable, safe, and available on-demand rides with a flat rate pricing model. The platform allows users to find and book rides by providing location and passenger information. The mobile application is available on the Android and iOS platforms. They provide features such as live vehicle tracking and a variety of payment options.
